question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given phrase.

A place where water is collected and stored for future use.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Reservoir"** refers to a large natural or artificial lake used as a source of water supply. (जलाशय)

 
 
• **Example: **The city relies on the reservoir for its drinking water supply.
 
 
 
• **"Reservoir" **is the correct word as it specifically denotes a place where water is collected and stored for future use. (जलाशय)
 
 
• **Example: **The dam created a reservoir to ensure a steady water supply during dry seasons.
 
 

Therefore, the correct one word substitution for the given phrase is **Reservoir**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Aquarium **(मछलीघर): A tank or pool or bowl filled with water for keeping live fish and underwater animals.

 
 
• **Example:** She loves watching the colorful fish swim in the **aquarium.**
 
 
 
• **Resort **(आरामगाह): A place that is frequented for holidays or recreation.
 
 
• **Example: **We spent our vacation at a beautiful beach** resort.**
 
 
 
• **Sanatorium** (आरोग्यशाला): A medical facility for long-term illness, typically associated with the treatment of tuberculosis.
 
 
• **Example:** He was admitted to a **sanatorium** for his treatment.
